claim_boundary: This is a mathematical/source-provenance gate. It contains no PCM production calculation, force result, runtime result, experimental solvation label, fit, or accuracy score.

mathematical_finding.induced_kernel: A neutral response covariance C and its source map B determine only the local induced-response curvature. They do not identify a molecular permanent electron density/reference state.
mathematical_finding.reference_shift: For every admissible neutral reference shift a, F_a(x)=1/2 (x-a)^T C^+ (x-a) has the same field response dx*/df=-C in the declared support, while B a changes the permanent surface potential.
mathematical_finding.continuum_extension: With Omega_a(x;f)=1/2 (x-a)^T C^+ (x-a)+1/2 (B x)^T Q (B x)+x^T f, the coupled response is -[C^+ + B^T Q B]^{-1} on support and remains independent of a. On-shell energy and continuum charge depend on B a.
mathematical_finding.transition_space_boundary: The frozen atomic independent-particle modes are individually neutral transition densities. They provide induced tangent directions, not the electron-number-bearing molecular reference density or its stationary gas-state functional.

current_asset_disposition.raw_mace_density_or_fixed_point: rejected: the field-conditioned MACE fixed point failed the common-scalar/reciprocity gate and cannot be relabelled as a stationary permanent electron density.
current_asset_disposition.atomic_independent_particle_response_cov: induced-response-only: it passes a one-acetone source gate for transition response, but C and B do not determine the permanent reference.
current_asset_disposition.free_atom_promolecular_density: source-control-only: it is a frozen positive free-atom source, not a molecular stationary electronic state.
current_asset_disposition.published_qeq_curvature: rejected: it fails the frozen acetone QM finite-field response gate and must not be repaired by hardness or response rescaling.
current_asset_disposition.harris_like_or_other_nonselfconsistent_e: rejected: a nonselfconsistent density/energy construction does not establish the required stationary molecular source.

admission_requirements_before_physical_c: A molecular permanent electron reference and exact nuclear source must be derived from one declared stationary electronic scalar in the same density/source dual space.
The source must be independently provenance-bound before any continuum calculation; it cannot be selected from a solvation error, a response error, or a convenience density.
The joined electronic-plus-continuum scalar must pass KKT, reciprocity, passivity, source-duality, coordinate-envelope, and force/PES gates.
Only after the frozen QM physics panel and runtime comparison may the immutable all-record multi-solvent and blind experimental protocols run.
decision_rule: Until a separately source-bound stationary permanent reference exists, current V0 response assets may remain only induced-response or frozen-source structural controls. They must not be coupled to a physical continuum, scored against experiment, or called total solvation.
